class.name: SplineMesh3D
class.description: SplineMesh3D generates an internal mesh by bending [member source_mesh] along a [Path3D] [Curve3D]. If [member path_node] is empty, the first child [Path3D] is used, falling back to the parent node when it is a [Path3D]. In the editor, a new SplineMesh3D creates a child [Path3D] with a short default curve when no path is available. The source mesh is interpreted using [member forward_axis] as its length axis and [member up_axis] as its local up direction. The generated mesh uses parallel transport frames by default to minimize unwanted twisting, then optionally applies [Curve3D] tilt. [member frame_mode] can be changed to use the [Curve3D]'s baked up vectors instead.

method.name: rebuild
method.description: Regenerates the internal mesh from [member source_mesh] and the current [Path3D] curve.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], curve positions are sampled with cubic interpolation.
The source mesh axis treated as the length direction to map onto the path.
Distance in meters between cached curve frames used by [constant FRAME_PARALLEL_TRANSPORT]. Smaller values follow sharp changes more closely.
Controls how orientation frames are generated along the curve.
Path to the [Path3D] whose [Curve3D] deforms the mesh. If empty, the first child [Path3D] is used, falling back to the parent node when it is a [Path3D].
The mesh to deform along the path. The generated mesh is assigned internally to the inherited [member MeshInstance3D.mesh] property.
If [code]true[/code], the source mesh length is stretched to the full curve length. If [code]false[/code], source mesh units map directly to path meters and are clamped to the path length.
If [code]true[/code], applies the [Curve3D] tilt around the path tangent.
The source mesh axis treated as local up. Must be different from [member forward_axis].
Controls how generated mesh UV coordinates are handled.
Distance in meters represented by one U coordinate unit when [member uv_mode] is [constant UV_PATH_DISTANCE]. Smaller values repeat the texture more frequently along the path.
Controls how the generated V coordinate is handled. Width-based modes use the source mesh width after applying [member forward_axis] and [member up_axis].
Distance in meters represented by one V coordinate unit when [member uv_v_mode] is [constant UV_V_DISTANCE]. Smaller values repeat the texture more frequently across the spline width.

If [code]true[/code], displays generated UV coordinates as vertex colors using a temporary debug material override. The previous [member GeometryInstance3D.material_override] is restored when this is disabled. Red shows U, green shows V, and blue alternates per UV tile.

constants.constant: Builds orientation frames by transporting the previous frame along the curve with minimal twist.
Uses the [Curve3D]'s baked up vectors. This requires [member Curve3D.up_vector_enabled] to be [code]true[/code].
Keeps the source mesh UV coordinates.
Recomputes the U coordinate from the vertex distance along the path while preserving the source V coordinate when available.
Keeps the source mesh V coordinate.
Recomputes the V coordinate by normalizing the source mesh width to the 0.0 to 1.0 range.
Recomputes the V coordinate from the vertex distance across the source mesh width in meters.
